turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
I know who you are, Hale. Who decided on Owen's zero?
You haven't answered me. Who decided?
You obviously put the hours in with him. His reading level is years ahead of the class.
Spare me. Who decided, and on what evidence?
You're the kind of parent I wish every kid had.
Flattery isn't evidence. Show me something, or I walk down to the principal.
So I'd love your blessing to handle this my way. I trust your judgment, and I hope you'll trust mine.
Your way put a zero in the gradebook before anyone called me. No.
